faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions – Invisalign Near Me

items.question: How long does Invisalign treatment take?
items.answer: Treatment time varies depending on the complexity of your case. During your consultation, your dentist will provide a personalized treatment timeline.

items.question: Is Invisalign painful?
items.answer: Most patients experience mild pressure when switching to a new aligner, which usually subsides within a few days.

items.question: Can I remove Invisalign aligners?
items.answer: Yes. Invisalign aligners are removable, allowing you to eat, brush, floss, and attend special occasions comfortably.

items.question: How many hours should I wear Invisalign each day?
items.answer: For the best results, Invisalign aligners should typically be worn for 20–22 hours per day, removing them only for eating, drinking (except water), and oral hygiene.

items.question: Is Invisalign suitable for adults?
items.answer: Yes. Invisalign is a popular orthodontic treatment for adults who want a discreet alternative to traditional braces.

items.question: What is the cost of Invisalign in Pune?
items.answer: The cost depends on your individual treatment requirements and complexity. A detailed consultation will provide an accurate estimate.

items.question: Why choose Invisalign instead of traditional braces?
items.answer: Invisalign offers clear, removable aligners that are comfortable, aesthetically pleasing, easier to clean, and allow you to maintain your regular lifestyle without the appearance of metal braces.
